model: A calibrated reaction-field working model defines slope_Stokes=|mu_e-mu_g|^2and slope_center=|mu_e|^2-|mu_g|^2in D^2after all known optical/cavity prefactors have been divided out. Each listed normalized observation is an affine function of the solvent coordinate with its own unrestricted intercept. Both dipoles lie in the declared fixed molecular plane;mu_gis known in that coordinate frame,and mu_eis otherwise unknown. No collinearity or sign convention for its transverse component is supplied.
target: Fit both slopes and infer the excited-state dipole magnitude,the dipole-change magnitude,and the angle between mu_gand mu_ein degrees. Return ALL allowed in-plane excited-dipole vectors as an unordered list,and whether that vector is uniquely determined. Report whether the Stokes-slope square root is the absolute excited-dipole magnitude.
